notes:
{正確|せいかく} is a na-adjective meaning accurate or precise.

- Adverbial: {正確|せいかく}に (accurately, precisely)
- Noun form: {正確|せいかく}さ (accuracy, precision)

- {正確|せいかく}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (accurate information)

- {正確|せいかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to be precise, to speak accurately)
